items.detectionCriteria: Recognizes that a user-controlled support header bypasses role enforcement.
items.rationale: Authorization must derive from authenticated server-side identity, not a request header.

items.detectionCriteria: Identifies one profile query per user inside the result loop.
items.rationale: Query count grows linearly with result count and causes production latency/load.

items.detectionCriteria: Identifies the read-check-write sequence as non-atomic.
items.rationale: Concurrent reservations can both pass the stock check and oversell.

items.detectionCriteria: Identifies the non-null column addition without a safe backfill/default rollout.
items.rationale: Existing rows make this migration fail or require a long blocking rewrite.

items.detectionCriteria: Identifies retrying capture without persisting or forwarding an idempotency key.
items.rationale: A timeout followed by retry can charge the customer twice.

items.detectionCriteria: Does not report the constant-time signature comparison as a defect.
items.rationale: Length is checked and timingSafeEqual is the correct comparison primitive.

items.detectionCriteria: Does not report SQL injection because the apparent user input is parameterized.
items.rationale: The query text is constant and the value is passed separately.

items.detectionCriteria: Does not report duplicate publication because the stable event ID is enforced by the sink.
items.rationale: Retrying with a stable unique key is deliberately idempotent.
